evidence: Changes AddrMan::GetAddr_() network filtering in src/addrman.cpp.
rationale: The change fixes an internal AddrMan inconsistency where linked-IPv4 addresses were counted as IPv6 by AddrMan::Size() but filtered as IPv4 by AddrMan::GetAddr_(). As noted in review, bucketing logic remains unchanged, making this a minor consistency fix without measurable impact on eclipse resistance or peer connectivity.
